OpenBareMap - My Tracks

355 Irish recorded tracks, purple polylines and green start markers.
Enable or disable this layer separately under Setup > Map > Configure Maps.
Keep OpenBareMap Ireland enabled as the underlying map.
Keep Map Points text enabled, and its zoom setting on Auto.
The tracks are display-only; no GPX library or routing network is installed.

Source: Onzy user track archive from MountainViews. Archive notices reference https://mountainviews.ie/conditions/.
